elements.name: Escape House Spa, go to top
Read all reviews on TripAdvisor (4.5 stars)
Contact Escape House Spa on WhatsApp

perceptions.text:
SCROLL
MAITAMA, ABUJA
Step out of
the noise.
Into stillness.
A sanctuary of Thai, Balinese and African body therapies in the heart of Abuja's most prestigious district. Cross the threshold and let the city dissolve.
BEGIN YOUR ESCAPE
EXPLORE THE RITUALS
"Where the city's energy dissolves the moment you step inside."
4.5
ON TRIPADVISOR
18K+
INSTAGRAM FOLLOWERS
10AM–2AM
OPEN EVERY DAY
UNISEX · MEN, WOMEN & CHILDREN
THE RITUALS
Treatments crafted for deep restoration
Every session performed by therapists trained in Thai, Balinese and African wellness traditions. Drag through, or simply scroll.
01 — Therapeutic
Body Massage
Full-body therapeutic massage targeting deep muscle tension, restoring circulation and releasing the weight of the day. Pressure tailored to your body.
FROM ₦15,000 BOOK THIS RITUAL
02 — Ancient Asia
Thai & Bali
Acupressure, passive stretching and rhythmic compression drawn from centuries-old Asian practice, realigning your energy and dissolving stress at the root.
FROM ₦20,000 BOOK THIS RITUAL
03 — Radiance
Facial Treatment
Deep-cleanse and glow facials with professional-grade products, targeting repair, hydration and a luminous, rested complexion.
FROM ₦12,000 BOOK THIS RITUAL
04 — Detail
Mani & Pedi
Luxurious nail and foot care, from classic grooming to spa-grade treatments with scrubs, soaks and impeccable finishing.
FROM ₦8,000 BOOK THIS RITUAL
05 — Together
Couples Escape
Side-by-side relaxation designed for two. Perfect for anniversaries, celebrations, or simply unwinding together away from the world.
FROM ₦40,000 BOOK THIS RITUAL
THE SPACES
Rooms built for letting go
Every corner of Escape House was designed with one intention: to give you a complete, uninterrupted escape.
Treatment Rooms
Private, dimly-lit and warm. Soft linen, low light and silence, the moment the door closes the city stops existing.
The Lounge
Arrive early, leave late. A quiet space to settle your breath before, and hold onto the calm after.
Couples Suite
Two beds, one room, shared stillness. Designed for celebrations and slow afternoons together.
THE ATMOSPHERE
A glimpse inside
BODY MASSAGE
4.5
STARS
OUR STORY
A sanctuary in the heart of Maitama
Nestled in Abuja's most prestigious district, Escape House began with a single belief: that peace should not be a luxury reserved for travel. The moment you step inside, the city's energy dissolves.
Our therapists are trained in Thai and Balinese techniques, bringing authentic Asian wellness traditions to Nigeria. Every session is tailored, every detail considered, every visit a complete reset.
Open daily from 10 AM to 2 AM, because your peace should not have a curfew.
18K+
INSTAGRAM
16 hrs
OPEN DAILY
Unisex
FOR EVERYONE
GUEST REVIEWS
In their own words

blockers.detail: The site handed the action off to WhatsApp in a separate tab. A browser agent cannot follow it, so the action cannot be finished in the browser.

verdict.summary: An AI agent failed to book an appointment. It found the right button and still could not finish. Primary blocker: dead-end-cta.
